text:
Take care, Claudia,

when you are with me,


because the slightest gesture,

any word, a sigh


from Claudia,

the smallest carelessness,


perhaps one day

scholars will examine it


And this dance of Claudia's

will be remembered for centuries


Claudia, I am warning you now.

translation.title: Take Care, Claudia
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the playful warning that intimacy may become literary evidence.
